in_marathi.name: Chandrashekhar
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chandrashekhar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Chandrashekhar is a Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit words chandra (moon) and shekhar (power, king). This name signifies the one who holds the power of the moon god.
